sources.content: CATAN rulebook, 12 pages. Page 1 cover; pages 2, 4-12 rules text with captions and examples; page 3 is the component overview, one picture per component design with its printed count
sources.layout: page 3 only: one box per pictured component design (52 designs); the card backs and the second side of the player aid are not separate items

fields.name: terrain_picture
fields.description: the landscape drawn on the hex: hills (orange-red broken land), forests (dense green trees), pastures (green meadow), fields (golden grain fields), mountains (grey rock), desert (pale sand)

fields.name: disc_number
fields.description: the large number printed in the centre of the disc (2 to 12); do not read the small dots

fields.name: pip_count
fields.description: number of small dots printed under the centre number; count only the dots

fields.name: number_colour
fields.description: colour of the large centre number: red or black

component_kinds.name: Player aid
component_kinds.back: the other side is headed PLAYER AID, TURN OVERVIEW (not cut as a separate item)
component_kinds.notes: one physical card per item; the front is cut

component_kinds.name: Development card
component_kinds.back: plain red card back with a round swirl emblem

component_kinds.name: Resource card

fields.name: resource_picture
fields.description: the resource the large middle picture shows: brick (red clay blocks), wood (logs), wool (sheep), wheat (golden sheaf on a field), ore (grey rock). Read the picture, not the corner icons

component_kinds.back: tan card back with a hexagon emblem

fields.name: colour
fields.description: colour of the die body: red (with a CATAN logo) or yellow

extraction_notes: game.credits was typed from the page 12 render, not read by the readers
Each of 52 unique designs (pixel-identical fronts grouped) was read by independent single-component model calls until every value had a majority; 50 designs were unanimous, 1 were resolved by hand.
